# The tightened copy of the C# metric ceilings: every threshold in gui/CodeMetricsConfig.txt,
# minus one.
#
# Not a stricter policy - the second half of a pinning check, and the exact counterpart of
# .github/clippy-tight/clippy.toml on the Rust side. A one-sided ratchet asks only whether the code
# is under the number, so it cannot see a number standing above the code, granting headroom nobody
# decided to grant. Asking whether the number STILL COSTS ANYTHING can.
#
# CI builds the solution a second time against this file and requires that build to FAIL. A pass
# would mean nothing in the GUI actually reaches either ceiling, and both have to come down to the
# real maxima.
#
# 🔴 Keep in step with gui/CodeMetricsConfig.txt. `MetricsCeilingTests` compares the two files rule
# by rule and fails unless every value here is exactly one below its counterpart.

CA1506: 81
CA1502: 17
